title: NMRFinesse: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: NMRFinesse automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE and records parameters and quality-control decisions. Version 1.0.11 improves project navigation, 1D/2D viewing, modal dialogs, native file browsing, peak-table calibration and CSV recovery, and project-level UCSF copying. It includes VMware mouse-wheel compatibility and updated bilingual help and software information. The Python/CLI API remains 1.1.5; existing processing and evidence results are unchanged.
